design.decision: Buy cheap [♦] cards for length and use swaps to keep [♦]; it rewards committing to the suit in the shop.
design.opponent: Revealed after bidding when it applies; a long [♦] team is easy to strip by voiding [♦].
design.rationale: Whole-hand counts measured best in the pilot; eight of thirteen is a natural team share about a third of the time, so this fits the common +mult budget, and bought [♦] cards raise the rate.
design.draftText: +15 contract multiplier if your team holds eight [♦]

critic.concerns: Fixed at the deal, so opponents have no counterplay; suit-only near-duplicate of ca-heart-hold-eight and ca-spade-hold-eight.
